about: The managing attorney of Caffee Accident & Injury Lawyers, located in Renton, Washington, Jeffrey Caffee provides legal representation to individuals in a wide range of personal injury matters. His practice focuses on personal injury litigation, including automobile accidents, trucking accidents, motorcycle accidents, bus accidents and cases involving wrongful death.

Mr. Caffee also handles complex claims involving catastrophic injuries, traumatic brain injuries and spinal injuries, as well as disputes related to automobile insurance coverage. He is dedicated to helping injured clients navigate the legal system while pursuing fair compensation for their losses.

With over 15 years of legal experience, Mr. Caffee has built a reputation as a committed and effective advocate for his clients. Known for his strategic approach and strong courtroom presence, he works diligently to protect the rights of those he represents. He approaches each case with careful preparation and a focus on achieving favorable outcomes while safeguarding his clients’ long-term interests.

Mr. Caffee earned his Bachelor of Science degree from Saint Leo University in 2003. He then went on to attend the University of Notre Dame Law School, where he received his Juris Doctor in 2009. During his time in law school, he developed the legal knowledge and advocacy skills that continue to inform his practice today.

Admitted to practice law in Washington in 2009, Mr. Caffee is an active member of several professional organizations. His affiliations include the King County Bar Association, the Washington State Association for Justice, the Tacoma-Pierce County Bar Association, the Washington State Bar Association and the National Trial Lawyers. He has also been involved with the Washington Employment Lawyers Association and the King County Bar Association’s Real Property, Probate and Trust Section, as well as the American Association for Justice.
